titre: Premier lot : mots pièges, combinaisons, phrasal verbs, phrases

cartes.def: In spite of what was just said; however.
cartes.ex: The plan was risky. Nonetheless, we went ahead.

cartes.def: Pleasant to use or be in; relaxed and at ease.
cartes.ex: These shoes are really comfortable.

cartes.def: The day after Tuesday.
cartes.ex: Let's meet on Wednesday.

cartes.def: A senior military officer, above a major.
cartes.ex: The colonel gave the order to move out.

cartes.def: Money that you owe someone.
cartes.ex: He's still paying off his student debt.

cartes.def: Many times; frequently.
cartes.ex: How often do you work out?

cartes.def: Plural of woman.
cartes.ex: Two women were waiting outside.

cartes.def: Having a lot to do; full of activity.
cartes.ex: Sorry, I'm super busy today.

cartes.def: A reply; to reply to a question, call or message.
cartes.ex: She didn't answer my text.

cartes.def: A strong metal; also a device for pressing clothes.
cartes.ex: I need to iron my shirt.

cartes.def: The things you wear.
cartes.ex: I packed enough clothes for a week.

cartes.def: Very likely.
cartes.ex: I'll probably be a little late.

cartes.def: A plant or part of a plant eaten as food.
cartes.ex: You should eat more vegetables.

cartes.def: To decide, or to find out exactly.
cartes.ex: We need to determine what caused the problem.

cartes.def: To have enough money or time for something.
cartes.ex: I can't afford a new car right now.

cartes.def: Despite the fact that.
cartes.ex: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.

cartes.def: Careful and complete, with attention to every detail.
cartes.ex: She did a really thorough job.

cartes.def: Introduces a choice or doubt: if.
cartes.ex: I'm not sure whether he's coming.

cartes.def: The clear liquid we drink.
cartes.ex: Can I get some water?

cartes.def: A large town.
cartes.ex: New York is a huge city.

cartes.def: A small round fastener on clothes; something you press on a device.
cartes.ex: Press the red button.

cartes.def: The best result ever achieved; also a written account.
cartes.ex: She broke the world record.

cartes.def: To store sound or images; to write something down.
cartes.ex: We recorded the whole meeting.

cartes.def: The art or job of taking photos.
cartes.ex: He's really into street photography.

cartes.def: Instructions for cooking a dish.
cartes.ex: Can you send me the recipe?

cartes.def: A perfect example of a quality or type.
cartes.ex: She's the epitome of calm.

cartes.def: Small and not obvious, but noticeable if you pay attention.
cartes.ex: There's a subtle difference between the two.

cartes.def: A piece of land surrounded by water.
cartes.ex: They live on a small island.

cartes.def: A plan of what will happen and when.
cartes.ex: Let me check my schedule.

cartes.def: For one particular purpose or person; clearly and exactly.
cartes.ex: I specifically asked for no onions.

cartes.def: Especially; more than usual.
cartes.ex: I'm not particularly hungry.

cartes.def: Someone who starts and runs a business.
cartes.ex: She's a successful entrepreneur.

cartes.def: Deliberate exaggeration.
cartes.ex: Calling it the best movie ever is a bit of hyperbole.

cartes.def: A place where books are kept to read or borrow.
cartes.ex: I returned the books to the library.

cartes.def: Would be able to pay for (hypothetical or past).
cartes.ex: We could afford a bigger place if we moved.

cartes.def: Regret or criticism: telling was the right thing, but it didn't happen.
cartes.ex: You should have told me earlier.

cartes.def: Many or much.
cartes.ex: There were a lot of people at the party.

cartes.def: In no way; also a polite reply to thanks.
cartes.ex: I'm not tired at all.

cartes.def: The following day.
cartes.ex: The package arrived the next day.

cartes.def: Use an opportunity well; or unfairly use someone.
cartes.ex: Take advantage of the sale while it lasts.

cartes.def: Actually; adds a surprising or correcting detail.
cartes.ex: As a matter of fact, I've been there twice.

cartes.texte: at the end of the day
cartes.def: When everything is considered; ultimately.
cartes.ex: At the end of the day, it's your call.
cartes.lemme: at the end of the day

cartes.def: Would prefer to.
cartes.ex: I'd rather stay home tonight.

cartes.def: Describes a past habit or state that is no longer true.
cartes.ex: I used to live in Boston.

cartes.def: To wish to go somewhere.
cartes.ex: Do you want to go grab lunch?

cartes.def: Plan or intend to leave.
cartes.ex: I'm going to leave a bit early.

cartes.def: (have) got to: must.
cartes.ex: Sorry, I've got to go.

cartes.def: Question about having seen something.
cartes.ex: Did you see it last night?

cartes.def: Somewhat; a little.
cartes.ex: I'm kind of tired.

cartes.def: Regarding; when talking about.
cartes.ex: In terms of price, it's a great deal.

cartes.def: Find the answer or understand something by thinking.
cartes.ex: Don't worry, we'll figure it out.

cartes.def: Lift something; also collect someone, or learn something casually.
cartes.ex: It's on the floor, can you pick it up?

cartes.def: Tolerate something or someone annoying.
cartes.ex: I can't put up with this noise anymore.

cartes.def: Think of an idea, plan or answer.
cartes.ex: She came up with a great solution.

cartes.def: Happen in a particular way; prove to be.
cartes.ex: It turned out fine in the end.

cartes.def: Search for information in a dictionary or online.
cartes.ex: If you don't know the word, look it up.

cartes.def: Stop trying; or stop a habit.
cartes.ex: Don't give up now, you're almost there.

cartes.def: Have a friendly relationship with someone.
cartes.ex: I get along with all my coworkers.

cartes.def: Meet someone by chance; or meet a problem.
cartes.ex: I ran into an old friend downtown.

cartes.def: Admitting that you should have shared something earlier.

cartes.texte: What are you going to do about it?
cartes.def: Asking someone how they plan to deal with a problem.

cartes.texte: Let me know if you need anything.
cartes.def: A friendly offer of help.

cartes.texte: I don't know what to do.
cartes.def: Expressing that you're stuck or unsure.
Saying something isn't important or serious.
The usual way to order in a café.
